label: Where
value: East of Madyan, Swat District, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
quote: is an alpine glacial lake located to the eastern side of Madyan in Swat District

label: Getting there
value: Four-wheel drive or ordinary vehicle, about 40 to 50 minutes to the valley
quote: It takes almost forty to fifty minutes to reach this picturesque valley

label: Hike
value: Four to five hours on foot from the valley
quote: trekking of four to five hours, depending on professionalism and enthusiasm of the trekkers

label: Best months
value: April to May for Swat; June to August for the cool Upper Swat areas
quote: April to May is the best time to visit Swat, when the fresh green grass carpet covers the slopes.
source: Wikivoyage: Swat (general Swat advice, not specific to the lake)

label: Also called
quote: also known as Bashigram Danda in Pashto
